gates.name: core_exact_law_mae
gates.requirement: Full-estimate exact-law validation must be near numerical precision.
gates.action: If this fails, inspect tie handling, score alignment, and measurement/simulation parity; do not change labels or omit failures.

gates.name: moment_hierarchy_exactness
gates.requirement: Moment-law prediction should be exact up to floating-point error when using the full empirical distribution.
gates.action: If this fails, fix the moment/rank formula before scaling any new experiments.

gates.name: expanded_pilot_proxy_K128_N8
gates.requirement: Existing 256-sample proxy is diagnostic pre-flight evidence for the pilot-forecasting target, not final proof.
gates.action: If this diagnostic proxy fails, do not overclaim tiny-pilot sufficiency; the next legitimate step is the full 4096-sample locked split, with estimator selection on calibration data only and final reporting on the independent evaluation pool.

gates.name: expanded_pilot_proxy_K256_N8
gates.requirement: Existing 256-sample proxy is diagnostic pre-flight evidence for the pilot-forecasting target, not final proof.
gates.action: This proxy pool cannot certify the gate at this K; run the 4096-sample locked split and select estimators only on calibration data.

gates.name: maxed_heldout_K128_N8
gates.requirement: Maxed-out held-out forecasting must hit the paper's sample-complexity gate on independent evaluation.
gates.action: If this fails, improve estimators on pilot/calibration only, add samples, or scope the claim to the observed sample-complexity curve.

gates.name: maxed_heldout_K256_N8
gates.requirement: Maxed-out held-out forecasting must hit the paper's sample-complexity gate on independent evaluation.
gates.action: If this fails, improve estimators on pilot/calibration only, add samples, or scope the claim to the observed sample-complexity curve.

gates.name: maxed_heldout_K512_N8
gates.requirement: Maxed-out held-out forecasting must hit the paper's sample-complexity gate on independent evaluation.
gates.action: If this fails, improve estimators on pilot/calibration only, add samples, or scope the claim to the observed sample-complexity curve.

gates.name: live_judge_delta_over_logprob
gates.requirement: A real judge/verifier should beat mean logprob by at least +0.03 at high N.
gates.action: If this fails, add independent judges, calibrate judge ensembles on calibration data, and evaluate once on held-out pairs.

gates.name: maxed_live_judge_coverage
gates.requirement: Maxed-out live-judge claim needs complete model/problem coverage for the live panel.
gates.action: Run the live judge command queue to completion; keep existing 135-pair result scoped as a subset until then.

gates.name: cross_benchmark_exact_law
gates.requirement: Every completed benchmark should hit the exact-law MAE and grading-coverage gate.
gates.action: If this fails, fix grader/score alignment before adding more benchmarks.

gates.name: cross_benchmark_family_count
gates.requirement: The maximum generalization claim needs at least six benchmark families.
gates.action: Run and measure the two missing families, MATH500 and MBPP-backed humaneval_mbpp, before claiming six-family generality.

gates.name: maxed_cross_benchmark_scale
gates.threshold: 6 families at manifest task limit, sample depth, model count, and 100% measured coverage
gates.requirement: The maximum cross-benchmark claim requires the manifest-scale run, not smoke-scale family presence.
gates.action: Run the full cross-benchmark command queue with 500 requested tasks, 128 samples/task, and the full live model panel; then regenerate analysis.

gates.name: adaptive_allocation_delta
gates.requirement: Moment-law allocation should beat uniform under fixed budget.
gates.action: If this fails, tune allocation policies on calibration seeds only and preserve oracle/uniform baselines.
